links.comparator_used: Long-context prompting with the most recent clinical notes (varying amounts of context) across GPT-5.4-mini, Mistral Medium 3 and DeepSeek V3.1
links.outcome: Task performance (F1 for imaging procedure extraction, Jaccard for antibiotic timelines, diagnosis generation) and token use
links.effect: Imaging Procedures: RAG exceeded long-context performance by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models using fewer than 8K tokens. Antibiotic Timelines: <8K retrieved tokens matched long-context recent-notes performance (between -3.26 and +3.24 Jaccard). Diagnosis Generation: performance largely static across methods and models.
links.tradeoff: No gain for diagnosis generation, the hardest task. Missing information in the notes, often from inter-hospital transfers, limited performance to some extent.
links.quote: For Imaging Procedures, RAG strongly outperformed recent-note inputs and exceeded long-context performance (by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models) using fewer than 8K tokens.
